# Pressbooks@MSL (Cleveland State University)

> An open educational resource platform hosting peer-reviewed, interactive textbooks and open-access course materials under Creative Commons licenses.

Pressbooks@MSL is Cleveland State University's open publishing initiative managed by MSL Academic Endeavors. It provides freely accessible, high-quality educational content designed for first-year writing, rhetoric, and accessible design, serving students and educators across multiple disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- First-Year Writing
- Rhetoric and Genre
- Creative Commons Licensing
- Pressbooks Platform
- Interactive Textbooks
- Accessible Design
- Academic Publishing
- Cleveland State University
- MSL Academic Endeavors
- CC BY-NC-SA
- Writing Skills
- Genre Analysis
- Searchable Repository
- Open Textbook

## OER Catalog & Discovery

- [Catalog – Pressbooks@MSL](https://pressbooks.ulib.csuohio.edu/catalog): Searchable OER catalog of Cleveland State University open educational resources with subject filtering and Creative Commons licensing information

## First-Year Writing & Rhetoric

- [A Guide to Rhetoric, Genre, and Success in First-Year Writing (The Interactive 2nd Edition) – Open Textbook](https://pressbooks.ulib.csuohio.edu/csueng100101fall2023): Interactive open textbook on rhetoric, genre analysis, and writing skills by Gagich, Zickel, Lloyd, Morgan, and Lanning

## Accessible Design & Best Practices

- [Best Practices in Accessible Online Design – Simple Book Production](https://pressbooks.ulib.csuohio.edu/accessibility): Design guide for web accessibility best practices and inclusive online content creation

## Optional

- [1st Edition: A Guide to Rhetoric, Genre, and Success in First-Year Writing (No Longer Updated) – Open Textbook](https://pressbooks.ulib.csuohio.edu/csu-fyw-rhetoric): Archived first edition of rhetoric and writing guide; superseded by the Interactive 2nd Edition
